name: ATAF guide to taxing high-net-worth individuals in Africa (April 2026)
detail: The African Tax Administration Forum (an AU-recognised technical body) frames effective taxation of high-net-worth individuals as fairness and a way to broaden the tax base through enforcement of existing taxes; no tax on the stock of wealth is proposed. Its executive director Mary Baine: effective taxation of high-net-worth individuals can broaden the tax base.

name: Zimbabwe wealth tax on residential property (Finance Act 2023)
detail: A 1% levy on residential property above US$250,000 (main home excluded): a property tax, not a tax on net wealth. Collection halted in 2025. Zimbabwe has five PAP members; none was found backing a net wealth tax.
